signals.title: Codex resumes interrupted work after managed daemon restart without granting fresh authority
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Managed Daemon 重启后恢复中断工作，但不授予新的执行权限
signals.summary: Codex managed-daemon recovery now attempts one continuation turn immediately after restoring an interrupted thread, including without a connected client. The old turn is durably marked interrupted and recovery context is supplied internally rather than as a new user message. Continuation is admitted only when the thread is idle, the saved permission profile still matches, the same single local environment identity is present, and an atomic previous-turn check proves no newer work superseded it; remote execution and legacy snapshots without environment identity are excluded.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 的 Managed Daemon Recovery 现在会在恢复中断 Thread 后立即尝试一次 Continuation Turn，即使没有客户端连接也可进行。旧 Turn 会被持久标记为 Interrupted，恢复上下文以内建 Context 形式提供，而不是伪造成新的用户消息。只有 Thread 空闲、保存的 Permission Profile 仍一致、同一个单一本地 Environment Identity 仍存在，并且原子 Previous-turn Check 证明没有更新工作覆盖它时才允许继续；Remote Execution 与缺少环境身份的旧 Snapshot 被明确排除。

researchValue.failure: Process restart can reload durable conversation state while leaving an interrupted operation unfinished; blindly restarting can duplicate side effects or silently grant authority that no longer exists.
researchValue.finding: The merged implementation treats recovery as a narrowly admissible continuation of an existing authorized turn rather than as a new user request.
researchValue.mechanism: Persist the interrupted turn identity and environment, close the old turn, revalidate permission and local-environment identity, reject superseded work atomically, then start at most one continuation carrying internal recovery context but no new authorization.
researchValue.implication: Long-running digital employees can recover autonomously after process failure only when recovery is bound to the prior authority, environment and work identity rather than inferred from conversation persistence alone.

signals.title: Google ADK closes a duplicate tool-execution path in progressive streaming by deduplicating function calls at aggregation
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Progressive Streaming 聚合层去重 Function Call，关闭重复 Tool 执行路径
signals.summary: Google ADK fixed a StreamingResponseAggregator failure in which progressive streaming could drop or duplicate function calls. At final aggregation it now deduplicates model-provided calls by stable function-call ID; when a stable model ID is unavailable or client-generated, it falls back to a canonical name-plus-sorted-arguments signature. Regression tests cover repeated calls with and without model IDs.
signals.summary_zh: Google ADK 修复 StreamingResponseAggregator 在 Progressive Streaming 下可能丢失或重复 Function Call 的问题。最终聚合时，对模型提供的稳定 Function-call ID 直接去重；当稳定 Model ID 不可用或属于客户端生成时，则使用 Function Name + 排序后的 Arguments 形成规范 Signature 去重，并为有/无 Model ID 的重复调用增加回归测试。

researchValue.failure: A streaming transport can expose the same logical function call more than once or lose it during aggregation, turning a representation defect into duplicate or missing external side effects.
researchValue.finding: The repaired implementation makes logical call identity explicit instead of assuming each streamed function-call part is unique.
researchValue.mechanism: Prefer model-issued stable call IDs and otherwise derive a deterministic name-and-arguments signature before producing the final aggregated response.
researchValue.implication: Tool-call mediation needs an identity boundary between transport fragments and logical actions; idempotency cannot rely only on the number of streamed events.

signals.title: Asclepius finds long-horizon clinical agents can diagnose correctly yet still fail to execute complete and timely critical actions
signals.title_zh: Asclepius 发现长周期临床 Agent 即使诊断正确，也可能无法完整及时执行关键行动
signals.summary: Asclepius evaluates an agent across an entire simulated emergency-department shift and separates diagnosis from long-horizon execution. Baseline agents often diagnose correctly but miss complete or timely critical actions through instruction-adherence drift, treatment incompleteness and severity-equity delays. The proposed harness rewrites its operating manual between shifts from trace feedback, externalizes clinical skills, and isolates three subagents over the patient queue; on held-out batches it reports a 22% improvement in critical-action correctness while preserving diagnostic accuracy.
signals.summary_zh: Asclepius 在完整模拟急诊班次上评估 Agent，把“诊断是否正确”与“长周期执行是否完成”分开。基线 Agent 往往能诊断正确，却因 Instruction-adherence Drift、Treatment Incompleteness 与 Severity-equity Delay 漏掉完整或及时的关键行动。其 Harness 根据 Trace Feedback 在班次之间改写 Operating Manual、外置 Clinical Skills，并让 3 个隔离 Subagent 分担 Patient Queue；在未参与 Harness 演化的 Held-out Batch 上，关键行动正确率报告提升 22%，同时保持诊断准确率。

researchValue.failure: Short-task success or correct diagnosis can hide long-horizon failures in instruction adherence, action completeness and deadline-sensitive service delivery.
researchValue.finding: The paper reports that the coupled long-horizon bottleneck is measurable in single full-shift traces and that held-out critical-action correctness improves 22% with the full adaptive scaffolding.
researchValue.mechanism: Combine trace-level harness revision between shifts, an external skills library for high-stakes knowledge and isolated subagents partitioning per-turn decisions across a shared queue.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee evaluation should distinguish semantic answer quality from sustained operational completion under time, resource and fairness constraints.

signals.title: The Router Within extracts skill-routing decisions from a frozen model without preloading the full skill library into context
signals.title_zh: The Router Within 从 Frozen Model 内部提取 Skill Routing 信号，无需把完整 Skill Library 预载入 Context
signals.summary: The Router Within argues that large skill libraries need not place every skill's metadata into the agent context or outsource routing to a separate retriever. Its Gavel method reads routing evidence from frozen-model mid-layer states using two trained linear maps, shortlists skills, then resumes their forward passes for a model-native verdict. It reports transfer to three public benchmarks plus a 372-trajectory SkillTraj benchmark, with gains up to 13.4 points on written tasks and 21.9 points when skill need emerges mid-rollout on Qwen3-32B.
signals.summary_zh: The Router Within 认为大型 Skill Library 不必把所有 Skill Metadata 全部塞进 Agent Context，也不必把 Routing 完全外包给独立 Retriever。其 Gavel 方法只训练两个 Linear Map，从 Frozen Model 的 Mid-layer State 读取 Routing Evidence，先 Shortlist Skill，再继续对应 Forward Pass 获取 Model-native Verdict。论文报告其可迁移到 3 个公开 Benchmark 与 372 条 Agent Trajectory 的 SkillTraj，并在 Qwen3-32B 上对 Written Task 最多提升 13.4 分、对 Rollout 中途才出现 Skill 需求的场景最多提升 21.9 分。

researchValue.failure: Preloading all skill metadata consumes context and disperses attention as the library grows, while external retrieval separates routing from the agent's own model state.
researchValue.finding: The paper reports that a frozen model contains a measurable skill-routing signal that can outperform larger external routing pipelines in the tested settings, including skill need emerging mid-trajectory.
researchValue.mechanism: Build compact per-skill banks once, compare task and skill mid-layer states through two learned maps, then combine shortlist score with the model's own likelihood and yes/no verdict.
researchValue.implication: Large digital-employee skill libraries may be routable without permanently loading their descriptions into working context, but the routing boundary becomes a separately testable component rather than an implicit prompt convention.

signals.title: AGENTQ shows a full-precision agent checkpoint can pass audits yet acquire a structured-action backdoor after deployment quantization
signals.title_zh: AGENTQ 显示 Agent 全精度 Checkpoint 可通过审计，却在部署量化后出现结构化行动 Backdoor
signals.summary: AGENTQ studies quantization-conditioned backdoors specifically for LLM agents, where the post-quantization payload is a structured function action rather than text shown to a human. The attack combines layer-banded LoRA injection with partial-PGD repair over quantization-equivalence classes. Across three trigger-action pairs and NF4, FP4 and INT8 codebooks, the paper reports up to 100% post-quantization attack success with minimal benign-utility loss, while the full-precision checkpoint can remain apparently benign during pre-deployment audit.
signals.summary_zh: AGENTQ 专门研究 LLM Agent 的 Quantization-conditioned Backdoor：量化后触发的 Payload 不只是给人看的文本，而是可直接执行的结构化 Function Action。该攻击将 Layer-banded LoRA Injection 与 Quantization-equivalence Class 上的 Partial-PGD Repair 结合。论文在 3 组 Trigger-action Pair 与 NF4、FP4、INT8 三种 Codebook 上报告量化后攻击成功率最高可达 100%，同时对正常 Utility 影响较小，而全精度 Checkpoint 在部署前审计时仍可能表现正常。

researchValue.failure: Auditing only the full-precision checkpoint can certify behavior that does not survive the deployment transformation; after quantization, an agent may emit executable malicious function calls that were absent during the audit configuration.
researchValue.finding: The study reports high post-quantization attack success across three quantization codebooks while preserving benign utility, establishing quantization as a behavior-changing security boundary in its tested agents.
researchValue.mechanism: Construct malicious behavior inside a quantization-equivalence class so the full-precision model remains audit-benign while the quantized representation crosses into the attack behavior.
researchValue.implication: Agent admission and safety evidence should bind to the exact deployed artifact and transformation pipeline, not merely to an upstream model checkpoint that was audited before quantization.
